summary: Brookfield Renewable Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from a special shareholder meeting held October 14, 2026, tied to a joint management information circular dated August 26, 2026. The BEPC Transaction Resolution received 94.62% approval from Exchangeable Shares and Class B Shares voting together, and 70.33% approval from Exchangeable Shares voting separately as a class. Quorum was 66.50% of Exchangeable Shares and 100% of Class B Shares. This is a routine post-meeting report with no standalone deal terms; the underlying transaction was previously disclosed.
